description: Wonderwhales signal with one virtual position on XAUUSDm. PSAR-flip exit, PSAR/ATR%/fixed stop, CSV logs only; no order API.

assumptions.symbol: XAUUSDm: point 0.001, 3 digits, trade contract size 100; measured spread ~260 points. P&L model intentionally uses contract size 1
assumptions.entry: virtual fill at ask/bid plus adverse slippage on the closed-bar signal
assumptions.stop: distance from fill; PSAR mode falls back to rejection when the line is on the wrong side or too close
assumptions.exit: SL hit (checked first), optional opposite signal, optional max holding bars
assumptions.commission: total cash per fill, charged on open and close
assumptions.pnl_units: price difference multiplied by virtual volume; not broker money
